summary: recreation.gov record, rates and catalog read: USACE, 61 electric sites (30 A at 56, 50 A at 5), water+sewer at 15, 30-80 ft, 5 pull-throughs; $16 ($24 full hookup; 2026, 2027); 100% reservable, 2-night weekend / 3-night holiday minimums, 14 in 30; showers, flush toilets, dump, water. Stored count 80 (derived) -> 61. AWH note trimmed (count/booking), --Claude line added. Waterfront --AWH lakefront: measurements DISAGREE (lakeview by the bluff rule): report only. Pin fine.
flags: WATERFRONT (stored lakefront, --AWH 'some waterfont': NOT changed; disagreement reported): the best tagged sites, east-shore 50 (39.449820,-88.740389), 51 (39.450557,-88.739938), 52 (39.450932,-88.739705) and 53 (39.451413,-88.739535), sit 10-12 m above the 182.8 m summer pool with water at ~33-40 m down a steep bank (e.g. 52: 194.5 m pad, 189.8 at 20 m, 183.9 at 30 m); imagery shows a band of trees between the pads and a sand strip at the water. The other tagged sites (12-19, 33-38, 42, 43, 47-49) are 80 m+ from the pool or have none within 100 m. rec.gov: 'The banks are steep and it may be difficult to get to the water from many sites'; 'heavily forested'. By the same bluff/canopy rule p3-463 applied at Bo Wood and McNair this is LAKEVIEW; AWH's value stands for the reviewer.
